note: Faction-neutral subjects (terrain and resources). Factions never change terrain; the terrain recipe class also omits the faction layer.

subjects.TERRAIN:GRASS: Subject: a wide flat meadow of short lawn grass seen from directly above, one even calm mid-green base colour with small darker grass tufts scattered evenly and sparsely all over, nothing else.
subjects.TERRAIN:FOREST: Subject: a dense clump of three or four chunky round-crowned trees and one pine packed tightly together, muted deep green and olive leaves in big simple blobs, short dark grey-brown trunks, the clump as wide as the image; the tree trunks are the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow under them.
subjects.TERRAIN:MOUNTAIN: Subject: a chunky rocky mountain, just rock and snow: two or three steep cool grey stone peaks with small white snow caps, big simple rock faces in two grey tones, the mountain as wide as the image; no face, no eyes, no creature, no boulders at the foot; the foot of the rock is the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow around it.
subjects.TERRAIN:SHALLOW_WATER: Subject: a flat seamless water texture of calm shallow lagoon seen from directly above: one flat even light turquoise colour everywhere, with a few tiny pale wave ripple marks scattered evenly and sparsely, nothing else; open water only, no land anywhere.
subjects.TERRAIN:DEEP_WATER: Subject: a flat seamless water texture of calm deep open sea seen from directly above: one flat even deep blue colour everywhere, with a few tiny lighter wave marks scattered evenly and sparsely, nothing else; open water only, no land anywhere.
subjects.TERRAIN:MINED_MOUNTAIN: Subject: the same chunky rocky mountain with a mine dug into its foot: two or three steep cool grey stone peaks with small white snow caps, and in the front rock face a square mine entrance framed with pale birch timber beams around a dark tunnel, with a small mine cart heaped with grey ore standing beside it; no face, no eyes, no creature; the foot of the rock is the lowest thing in the image, with no ground, no grass patch, no soil and no shadow around it.
subjects.RESOURCE:FRUIT: Subject: a small round leafy fruit bush, soft sage-green leaves in three big simple blobs, with four or five big round soft peach-orange fruits hanging on it; muted, calm colours; the bush is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FERTILE_GROUND: Subject: a small tuft of ripe wheat: six or seven upright wheat stalks with big simple soft golden grain heads, bundled loosely, muted straw-gold colours; the wheat tuft is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:GAME: Subject: a small chunky cute deer standing and looking to the lower right, with a big head, short legs and small branching antlers, soft sandy-tan fur with a cream belly and a cream tail; muted, calm colours; the deer is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:ORE: Subject: a small chunky heap of three or four jagged angular chunks of raw copper-orange metal ore with sharp flat faceted faces and a few tiny bright pale-yellow glints, wedged into one small dark charcoal-black rock; warm burnt-orange metal with a dark brown shadow tone, so it stands out clearly against cool grey mountain stone; the ore heap is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FISH: Subject: one big plump fish leaping in an arc out of a tiny white water splash, a soft golden-yellow body with a dark blue back and big simple fins; the fish and the splash are the only things in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:PEARLS: Subject: one open chunky clam shell, soft lilac-grey with pale ridges, holding one big round glossy white pearl; muted, calm colours; the shell is the only thing in the image.
subjects.TREASURE: Subject: a small chunky treasure chest of pale golden birch planks with light steel bands, corners and a round steel lock, the lid slightly open showing a heap of gold coins inside; the chest is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:GAME/BOAR: Subject: a small chunky cute wild boar standing and looking to the lower right, with a big head, a short blunt snout with a dark grey nose, two tiny cream tusks, short stubby legs and a stiff dark crest of bristles along its back, soft ash-grey and dusky taupe fur with a pale cream snout; muted, calm colours; the boar is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:GAME/RABBIT: Subject: a small chunky cute wild rabbit sitting up and looking to the lower right, with a big round head, two long upright ears with pale cream insides, a tiny dark grey nose, a round fluffy white tail, soft light grey fur with a cream belly and muzzle; muted, calm colours; the rabbit is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FRUIT/BLUEBERRY: Subject: a small low wide blueberry shrub with no visible trunk, soft dark blue-green leaves in four big simple blobs, dotted with clusters of big round dusty indigo-blue blueberries; muted, calm colours; the shrub is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FRUIT/PEAR: Subject: a small young pear tree with a short thin trunk and a tall oval crown of soft sage-green leaves, with four big teardrop-shaped pale lime-green pears hanging on it; muted, calm colours; the tree is the only thing in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FISH/SHOAL: Subject: a little shoal of three small plump fish swimming close together towards the lower right, one in front and two behind, each with a soft golden-yellow body, a dark blue back and big simple fins, with two tiny white ripple marks beside them; the three fish and the ripples are the only things in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FISH/PAIR: Subject: two plump fish leaping out of one tiny white water splash in two arcs that cross, one fish heading up to the left and the other up to the right, each with a soft golden-yellow body, a dark blue back and big simple fins; the two fish and the splash are the only things in the image.
subjects.RESOURCE:FISH/DIVE: Subject: one big plump fish diving head first back into the water: its big forked tail fin and the back half of its soft golden-yellow body with a dark blue back stick straight up out of a small white splash with a few white drops flying up around it; the fish tail and the splash are the only things in the image.
subjects.TERRAIN:MOUNTAIN/GROUND: Subject: a flat seamless texture of bare rocky mountain ground seen from directly above: one flat even slate-grey colour everywhere, with many small flat lighter grey stone slabs, stone chips and pebbles of different sizes scattered evenly all over it and a few short darker cracks, nothing else; bare rock and scree only, no grass, no plants, no snow, no cliffs and no walls.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:WINDMILL/CALM: Subject: a windmill: one round tower of cream plaster on a pale stone footing with a small oak door, a dusty terracotta cone roof, and four big sail arms of oak lattice with plain cream canvas, set in a big X on the front and wider than the tower; no fence, no field. Buildings only.
